# Crypto API Directory

An open, read-only directory of cryptocurrency APIs for people, developers, and AI agents.

## Machine-readable catalogue

- Static catalogue snapshot: GET /catalog.json
- Human-readable directory: GET /

The catalogue is a static JSON file served directly by the hosting CDN. It is not a live data API and does not proxy requests to any listed provider.

Always inspect lastVerifiedAt before relying on a listing. Follow documentationUrl for provider-specific terms, authentication, rate limits, and commercial-use rules. This directory provides metadata only and does not redistribute provider data.
